Pinnacle: the first site cut off the scale model into the open world (openworld/PLAN-SITES.md): a 60 km square round Pinnacle Rock on map 5.1 at 1:1 on core/world, the NE rim's savannah kit growing on it, and the site planned on that ground as records (core/world KSITES, baked to plan/sites.json): the nine Beast Rider bands' camps on the floor round the rock (core/camp) and their tracks to it. The town on the mesa is settlements/pinnacle-rock's own. Verified: build.py, verify.py --assert. Read README.md
